Alpana Sinha

Bangalore, India|9538733842| alpana.sinha@outlook.com | LinkedIn |

ServiceNow Developer and CSA & CAD Certified professional with 5 years of experience, including 3 years in ServiceNow Development and 2 years in ServiceNow Administration. Skilled in ServiceNow ITSM, scripting, workflow automation, integrations, Performance Analytics, Now Assist and Virtual Agent, with strong expertise in designing, configuring, customizing, and delivering scalable ServiceNow solutions aligned with business requirements.

CERTIFICATION:

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator(CSA) | Issued: April 2026 ● ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) | Issued: August 2026 ● Preparing for ServiceNow CIS – DF Certification. EDUCATION: Post Graduate Diploma in Finance IMA – Manipal Academy of Banking Bangalore, Karnataka B.Tech in Electrical & Electronics Engineering Koustuv Institute of Technology, Odisha Bhubaneswar

2018 - 2019

2011 - 2015

TECHNICAL SKILL: ● ServiceNow Platform:

ITSM,

Incident Management, Problem Management, Change

Management, Knowledge Management, Service Catalog, Service Portal

ServiceNow Administration: User & Group Administration, Roles, ACLs, Forms, UI Policies, Data

Policies, SLAs, Notifications

ServiceNow Development: JavaScript, Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, GlideRecord,

GlideAjax, UI Actions, Flow Designer

Integrations: REST APIs, SOAP APIs, Import Sets, Transform Maps, Integration Hub. ● AI & Conversational Solutions: Now Assist, Virtual Agent, NLU, AI-Powered Automation, Conversational Workflows

Reporting & Analytics: Reports, Dashboards, Performance Analytics, KPI Tracking, Trend Analysis. ● Platform Operations Update Sets, Scheduled Jobs, Data Validation, Application Configuration, Troubleshooting.

EXPERIENCE:

Service Now Administrator (Freelance)

2025 - Present

Project 1: ServiceNow ITSM Reporting & Performance Analytics – Freelance Projects

Project Description: Implemented Reporting and Dashboard capabilities in ServiceNow to standardize KPI tracking, SLA monitoring, and request fulfilment visibility across regional teams. Enabled operational teams and management to monitor ticket trends, aging, and workload distribution through interactive dashboards.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Designed interactive dashboards and custom ITSM reports for Incident, Service Requests, and

Request Fulfilment performance.

Built trend and SLA compliance reports using Report Designer and dashboard widgets.

Created report sources and database views for cross-table reporting across Incident, Task, SLA,

and User tables using dot-walking.

Automated scheduled KPI report sharing and implemented role-based access to dashboards. ● Analysed ticket data to identify bottlenecks and improvement areas in request workflows. ● Performed data validation and root cause analysis to ensure reporting accuracy. ● Provided user training and created knowledge articles for effective dashboard and report usage. ● Supported UAT and post-go-live by resolving reporting enhancements and defects. April 2022-October 2023

Developed and customized ServiceNow solutions using Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script

Includes, GlideAjax, and server-side/client-side scripting to automate business processes.

Designed and enhanced Flow Designer workflows, Service Catalog Items, Catalog Client Scripts,

and request fulfilment processes to streamline user requests.

Built and maintained custom applications, forms, modules, and platform configurations based on



business requirements. Implemented REST/SOAP integrations, Import Sets, Transform Maps, and data migration solutions to enable seamless communication with external systems.

Performed testing, debugging, troubleshooting, UAT support, and deployment through Update

Sets, while working closely with administrators, stakeholders, and IT teams.

Impact & Achievements:



Improved workflow automation efficiency by reducing manual effort through optimized scripting and Flow Designer workflows.

Enhanced system integration reliability using structured REST/SOAP APIs with error handling



mechanisms. Improved request fulfilment speed by streamlining catalog workflows and automation logic

ICICI BANK, Bangalore – ServiceNow Developer ● Managed ServiceNow platform administration including user creation, role assignment, group

January 2019-March2022

management, and ACL-based access control to ensure secure user access.

Configured and maintained tables, forms, UI Policies, Data Policies, dictionary entries, and field

validations for ITSM modules (Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Requests).

Administered Service Catalog, Record Producers, notifications, SLAs, reports, and dashboards to

improve service delivery and operational visibility.

Supported instance maintenance, upgrades, troubleshooting, deployments using Update Sets,

and production issue resolution to maintain platform stability.

Collaborated with stakeholders to gather requirements, implement system enhancements, and

ensure alignment with ITIL best practices and banking compliance standards.

Impact & Achievements:

Improved SLA tracking accuracy by optimizing dashboards and automating KPI report generation. ● ● Reduced manual reporting effort by implementing automated scheduled reporting mechanisms. ● Enhanced incident visibility with KPI dashboards and trend reports.

INTERNSHIP

AtliQ Technologies | Data Analyst Internship | Certificate Available | Jul 15, 2024 – Aug 14, 2024
